class.name: UZUUIWorld
class.brief_description: Makes a world UI move: moving frames, opening, hover and ambient sway.
class.description: Add [UZUUIWorld] as a child of a screen's root [Control] whose theme comes from [method UZUUI.create_world_theme]. When the screen starts, it does the following: - Gives the frames (panels, tabs, buttons) the world's moving decoration ([method UZUUI.create_world_material]): a glint that sweeps across, a pulse, a flicker, or scan lines that flow. Text keeps its own material. - Opens the top-level panels with the world's motion ([method UZUUIJuice.apply_world_motion]). - Makes buttons swell on hover ([method UZUUIJuice.hover_pulse]). While it runs, it also sways ribbons and blinks the talk window's next mark, so the UI is never still. [code]ai_loop/uzu.py ui --world[/code] adds this node, and [code]ai_loop/uzu.py look ui-report[/code] reports what moved. [b]Note:[/b] This class is specific to U.ZU Engine.

method.name: advance
method.description: Advances the ambient motion (ribbon sway, next-mark blink) by [param delta] seconds. This is called every frame; tests call it directly.

method.name: decorate
method.description: Decorates the parent's tree now. This also happens when the node becomes ready. Returns [code]{"world", "panels", "buttons", "opened", "ribbons", "next_marks"}[/code].

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Returns the counts of the last [method decorate] and the ambient [code]time[/code], for self-verifying play.

members.member: Sways ribbons and blinks next marks while running.
Makes buttons swell when the mouse enters them.
Opens the top-level panels with the world's motion when the screen starts.
